question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class WebChat shortcut or prompt-snippet browser, and which surface should own shortcut definitions and storage?
rationale: The request is useful WebChat ergonomics, but implementation would add product surface and storage/config/API choices that current code does not already assign to a canonical owner.

options.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
options.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, or plugin metadata contract before building the UI so shortcut discovery has one canonical source of truth.

options.title: Keep it browser-local
options.body: Implement a Control UI-local shortcut list with import/export or local profile storage, avoiding gateway config while limiting cross-device sharing.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Hold this request until generic Control UI plugin-panel direction is settled, then make shortcuts a plugin or bundle surface if that boundary wins.

recommendation.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
recommendation.body: Define or extend a maintained command, skill, or plugin metadata contract before building the UI so shortcut discovery has one canonical source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-surface choice across Control UI, config, and plugin boundaries, and steipete is the strongest current-main UI routing signal available from local history.
